name_input: M/S RAYCHEM RPG PRIVATE LIMITED; RAYCHEM RPG PVT. LTD. (UNIT-2); M/S RAYCHEM R.P.G. PVT. LIMITED; RAYCHEM RPG PRIVATE LIMITED

Second page (RAYCHEM-RPG PRIVATE LIMITED, RPG House, 463 Dr. Annie Besant Road, Worli) shows 34,936 records with counterparties TYCO ELECTRONICS POLSKA SP. Z.O.O. (5,098), TE CONNECTIVITY CORPORATION, TYCO ELECTRONICS MEXICO, ELECTRIC HOUSE TRADING COMPANY (Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, 1,184), RS COMPONENTS LIMITED (UK), and ports Gdynia (590) and WARSAW (473) — i.e. outbound lanes to Poland/Saudi Arabia/UK. Source counter: ImportKey reports "Total Shipments 34936" for the Worli entity and "Total Shipments 9" for the 'RAYCHEM RPG PVT LTD' name variant; rows actually visible on the free pages: 3 (Worli page) + 5 (variant page) = 8 rows. Declared HS 850421 (liquid dielectric transformers) is NOT the HS seen in the visible records — visible export HS codes are 85369030, 83100090, 96121090, 96081019, 63053900; HS correction needed, not a rejection ground.
domestic_evidence: No verifiable domestic-supply record retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report revenue split could not be read: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (connection refused) for all queries. ImportKey's inbound records (e.g. "2026-02-28 | RAYCHEM-RPG PRIVATE LIMITED | TE CONNECTIVITY SOLUTIONS GMBH | Surge suppressors ... 85354030 | 1118548", Sahar Air Cargo ACC INBOM4) prove the company is an active operating importer/manufacturer in India but are not domestic-sale evidence. Domestic turnover: null — not public in accessible sources.
note: Legal entity exists and is active (RPG House, 463 Dr. Annie Besant Road, Worli, Mumbai; JV of RPG Enterprises and TE Connectivity). Export shipments are factually confirmed by customs/B-L records with date, destination and B/L number — not merely declared. Domestic supply side: no traces of supply records found in accessible sources; status left 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' because the registries/tender portals were blocked (403) and search was down, so absence is not established. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in accessible sources, not estimated. HS: declared 850421 does not match observed shipment HS codes; recommend correcting to the actual codes (85369030 junction boxes / 85354030 surge suppressors) with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer_trader (own manufacturing plus TE Connectivity group intra-firm trade). No rejection grounds.
